issue:
Title: cloning of TimeSeries

It's just a minor bug\!

When I clone a TimeSeries which has no items, I get an IllegalArgumentException \("Requires start <= end"\).
But I don't think the user should be responsible for checking whether the TimeSeries has any items or not.

Title: cloning of TimeSeries

input.issue_gist: Calling clone() on an empty JFreeChart TimeSeries throws IllegalArgumentException ("Requires start <= end") because clone → createCopy(0, -1) with an invalid range for empty series. Cloning an empty series should succeed and return an empty copy.

TimeSeries series = new TimeSeries("S1");
TimeSeries copy = (TimeSeries) series.clone();
concrete_examples.expected: Returns an empty TimeSeries copy with no exception.

concrete_examples.input:
TimeSeries series = new TimeSeries("S1");
series.createCopy(0, -1);  // the range clone() uses internally for an empty series
concrete_examples.expected: Returns an empty TimeSeries (or clone handles the empty case separately).
